firm_data.firm_description: Barrows Levy PLLC is a New York law firm providing quality legal services to clients in New York City and Long Island, focusing on family law and other legal matters. The firm offers extensive knowledge in Divorce and Family Law, Estate Planning, Elder Law, Probate and Administration Proceedings, Real Estate, Business Law, Litigation, Appellate Law, Personal Injury, Workers’ Compensation and Medical Device Regulation.
notable_facts: Locations in Garden City, Melville, and New York City
Over 95+ years of combined legal experience

email.subject: AI for Barrows Levy PLLC - built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Itamar,

With your focus on Divorce and Family Law across Garden City, Melville, and NYC, you're handling the kind of high-stakes cases where precision and client trust are everything. That's exactly where we see smaller practices getting squeezed by BigLaw workflows.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in the NY area to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
